# Whale Creek Co

Whale Creek Co is a residential general contractor based in Indianapolis, Indiana, specializing in outdoor living builds, decks, kitchen renovations, custom woodworking, millwork, CNC fabrication, and full-scope home remodeling.

## Services

- Deck and outdoor living construction (composite, cedar, pressure-treated)
- Screened porches and four-season room conversions
- Kitchen renovation and remodeling
- Custom millwork, cabinetry, and built-ins
- Custom woodworking and fabrication
- CNC milling and custom architectural details
- Interior and exterior home renovation
- General contracting for residential projects of all sizes

## Service Area

Indianapolis, Indiana and surrounding areas including Carmel, Fishers, Greenwood, Broad Ripple, Lawrence, Beech Grove, Speedway, Noblesville, and Westfield.

## About

Whale Creek Co is a versatile, one-stop-shop general contractor serving Indianapolis homeowners. Owner Dave leads a team of skilled craftsmen who handle projects from concept to completion — whether that's a custom deck, a full kitchen remodel, or a unique piece of fabricated furniture. The company is known for quality craftsmanship, clear communication, and personalized service.

4.7 stars across 14 Google reviews and 11 HomeAdvisor reviews.
